sources.notes: Road surfaces are triangulated directly between this layout's saved border rings. Elevation follows the approximately 65 m terrain raster, not a survey of the road. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations on curved boundaries; their locations, widths, heights and colours are assumed, not extracted from imagery. Banking is unknown. The source trace and borders have too many unmatched cross-sections for safe lap reconstruction. Lap playback is unavailable. Boundary coordinates and their separate feature-level licence are preserved. Imagery loads externally on demand; no image bytes or meshes are stored.
